parts.text: What is the policy on maternity leave duration, and what are the expense limits for daily meals and host gifts when traveling on business?

According to the Altostrat Singapore Employee Policy Handbook:

1. **Maternity Leave (Section 2.1)**: Eligible employees receive up to **24 weeks of paid Maternity Leave** (and up to **16 weeks for interns**) for birthing parents [Altostrat Singapore Employee Policy Handbook, Section 2.1: Maternity Leave (Singapore)].

2. **Host Gifts (Section 4.3)**: When staying with a friend or relative in lieu of a commercial hotel during business travel, employees are permitted to purchase a host gift of **up to US $50 per day**, supported by itemized receipts [Altostrat Singapore Employee Policy Handbook, Section 4.3: Lodging & Transportation Caps].

3. **Daily Meal Allowance (Section 4.4)**: Individual meals during business travel are capped at **US $120 per employee per day**, requiring itemized receipts [Altostrat Singapore Employee Policy Handbook, Section 4.4: Meal Allowances & Entertainment].
